Chapter 6670: Immortal Corpseworm

Chapter 6670: Immortal Corpseworm

Bao Pu paid the highest price, not only forsaking his humanity but also his body. He fused the worm with his dao and became an abomination.

He betrayed his masters to become one of the few immortals, gaining control over the world’s fate. He didn’t care about lesser beings’ opinions but Li Qiye’s disdain was another story.

“Sacred Teacher, witness my immortal dao.” He challenged.

Although his founder dao crumbled before one kick, he had already abandoned it. The dao was just there to feast on Three Immortals when necessary.

His immortal dao was his true root.

“The worm one?” Li Qiye reminded.

Sure, his dao couldn’t compare to a real immortal dao. However, he could ambush and kill a primordial immortal. Thus, he stood shoulder to shoulder with any of them, or so he thought. Zhan Sansheng and the others addressed him as “fellow daoist”.

Today, Li Qiye trampled on his proudest achievement and ability.

“Yes, Sacred Teacher!” He was furious and wanted to tear Li Qiye to pieces, no longer able to maintain his composure.

“I suppose your worm dao is effective in an ambush. Fine, you may try, I will not move.” Li Qiye said.

“Very well, then I will display my meager skill then.” Bao Pu opened his chest.

This worm technique had many limitations in a direct confrontation. However, Li Qiye said he was not going to move.

“Buzz.” Immortal rays surged from his chest and the worm started moving. It looked sacred somehow with an immortal energy.

Despite its transcendent aura, the worm still creeped everyone out as it moved out of his chest. Its head was only the size of a needle. Once it flashed, it virtually became undetectable by even overlords. Immortals wouldn’t notice its existence either if caught off guard.

Weizhen and the others shuddered, aware of the worm’s parasitic nature. It would be too late once it entered the body.

“Pop!” Suddenly, the worm appeared again. Its immortal light intensified and became fiery. The front grew to the size of a human head with an eight-petaled mouth.

“That’s disgusting.” Those who looked closer saw countless needles of light within the terrifying mouth. These turned out to be more mouths ready to devour an immortal.

The worm no longer had the transcendent aura in this form, only instilling fear into all spectators. All its mouths aimed at Li Qiye, illuminating him.

“Be careful!” Some couldn’t help but shout.
